info.instructions:
Custom MQM/STEL Annotation
Please evaluate the following translations by identifying and categorizing errors according to our custom taxonomy:
  • Accuracy: Issues with mistranslation, additions, omissions, or untranslated text.
  • Fluency: Grammar, punctuation, spelling, and word order issues.
  • Style: Awkward phrasing or register/style mismatches.
  • Audio-specific: For multimodal data, mark issues like background noise or speaker overlap.
Assign a severity to each error and provide an overall quality score (0-100).

data.src: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

tgt.ModelA: Le renard brun rapide saute par-dessus le chien paresseux.
